summary: Wrote PLAN.md (398 lines, UTF-8, the only file written) as the refined executable contract for NeuroAxis v11. Built by reading docs/SWARM_V11_PLAN.md and then verifying every interface claim against the shipped source: store.ts (1493 L), Header.tsx (105 L), Legend.tsx (142 L), TaxonomyTree.tsx (166 L), SectionCanvas.tsx (2507 L), sectionAssets.ts (257 L), SceneLayers.tsx (537 L), PlaneHelpers.tsx (285 L), planeGeometry.ts, clipPlanes.ts, corticalLobes.ts, load.ts, audit.mjs (4182 L), checks.mjs, audit-checks.test.mjs, closure-bite.mjs, division-toggles.mjs. Contents: (1) the exact two-row toggle contract - data-area/data-kind/data-division hooks, aria-pressed, and the accessible-name rule with the measured collision that forbids the text 'Vasculature' on any new control (it is a preset label clicked by exact text at audit.mjs:488 and :2353); Reset bound to applyViewPreset('brainstem-focus') and All bound to VIEW_PRESETS.all so neither invents a second definition of the default. (2) The AREA partition, total and disjoint over ALL_REGIONS (measured 236 taxonomy rows: 85/39/25/40/33/14; 7/7 regions owned exactly once) and the SYSTEMS partition over ALL_KINDS (88/53/11/25/45/14; 6/6), both derived from DIVISIONS/ALL_KINDS rather than retyped. (3) Where the preset row goes - demoted to a second, still-visible header row with a new data-preset hook, with the measured reason nothing may be collapsed or deleted. (4) The single-visibility-decision rule, with a per-path table proving all seven 3D and 2D paths are already region-aware, plus the one real defect to fix (buildLobeLayer's implicit gate) and two known non-defects nobody should 'fix'. (5) The 3a arithmetic settling the AXIS_PAIR question: the shipped canonical convention y->['x','z'], x->['z','y'], z->['x','y'] yields a correct 148x171 sagittal quad, while audit.mjs:3127's ascending-axis-name filter is the wrong side. (6) The 3b finding: the item-4 divergence is already fixed and the spec's '[]-vs-six' premise is stale; the surviving defect is that audit.mjs:278-309 hardcodes the expected division set instead of re-deriving it, the recorded cause being ribbon COVERAGE (the canvas paints l+r, the gate's per-plane tables slice l only). (7) Section 5, the exhaustive preset-label reference list with line numbers (5 click/selector sites, 5 name-grade sites, 4 name fixtures, plus prose), including the measured negative that 'Cortex only' is never clicked anywhere. (8) Section 9, sixteen numbered statements of where the spec is wrong or under-specified, not silently fixed. Verification: all 13 non-browser gates re-run green at base with printed numbers (validate 0 errors/0 warnings, tsc exit 0, pipeline 138/138, plane 10827, somatotopy 45/0, division-toggles 250/0, plane-helper-extent 196/0, cortical-lobes 519/519, pip-contract 187/0, audit-checks 92/0, closure-bite 7/7, boundary-contract 22/0, a11y-contract 38/0, budget-report 5/0) and both environmental reds reproduced (verify:anatomy and verify:imaging-fit exit 1 with EPERM before any assertion runs; the Chrome lanes are never claimed). 71 cited file:line claims were validated mechanically (all exact after one corrected range). The 3b coverage claim was independently reproduced by re-running the v10 scratch probe .dsh-scratch/review-qa-cort/artefact-planes.mjs (exit 0, both ribbons): every painted-division set across 14 planes matches audit.mjs's ARTEFACT_PLANES table exactly, and at y=6 the left ribbon alone yields 4 divisions while l+r yields the table's 5. That probe also surfaced a new measured fact now recorded in section 9.16: the shipped MIN_DIVISION_AREA_AU2 is 25 (corticalLobes.ts:362), not the 10 the v10 plan documented.
